About this item

  • ★ Protect Your Eyes With Style ▶ We created our polarized sunglasses men women to protect your eyes while you are out under the harmful sun UV rays and to make you look Irresistible at the same time. Whether you are driving, walking or working, whether you are a man or a woman, prepare yourself for all the prime attention you can get and the envy of all of those who can’t figure out your little secret: Your KALIYADI Sunglasses.
  • ★ Be More Relaxed Every Day ▶ Those sunglasses come with top rated polarized lenses that we tested over time. Polarization reduces glare reflected by mirrors, shiny or polished materials or any other kind of sun rays reflection. You will feel your eyes permanently relaxed because you will not squint anymore! Whether you are driving to work or having a nice sunbath on the beach, you will be less tired at the end of the day because your eyes are more relaxed.
  • ★ See The World In Its True Colors ▶ The HD polarized lens of our sunglasses mens offer true color perception because of the neutral color coating and clear vision by eliminating reflected and scattered light. Therefore you will be able to enjoy the sunglasses during all outdoor activities, driving, fishing or any water sport as well. Just imagine how good you will feel not having to worry about eyes health while being able to enjoy and admire the world in every beautiful detail.
  • ★ Move Free And Feel Free ▶ We know how uncomfortable frames can be and how this affects every wearer. We care about your vision and want to help you keep your sun glasses on for as long as you need them. Therefore we picked ultra-light materials for glasses frame, shatterproof polarized lenses and we took care so that every edge is smoothed and polished so you’ll even forget that you wear them out in the sun. Wearing sunglasses has never been more relaxing, secure and comfortable than now!
  • ★ Gift Idea Package and Brand Customer Service ▶ Classic sunglasses*2, microfiber pouch*2, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*2, gift box*1. Our sunglasses for men women are also gift packed, which will be great gifts for your family and friends! All KALIYADI customers enjoy brand customer service for our polarized sunglasses. The integrity of every box and the quality of the lenses are double checked by third-party companies. And that goes with a lifetime support!

The quality of our KALIYADI Polarized Sunglasses differentiates us from competitors making those stylish shades stand out from the crowd. The pack contains:

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Affordable Style and Comfort - Unisex, Functional, and High-value Sunglasses!
    Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2023
    Color: B02- (2 Pack) Glossy Black/Matte Blackish GreenLens Color: multicolored
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The KALIYADI Polarized Sunglasses are a remarkable blend of style, functionality, and affordability. I've already purchased two pairs, a testament to their quality and my satisfaction!

    One of the standout features of these sunglasses is their unisex design. Their sleek semi-rimless frame is effortlessly trendy, fitting both me and my partner perfectly. It's a versatile accessory that adds a fashionable edge to any outfit.

    While the black rim version has its charm, I found the spotted version exudes a slightly more premium feel. However, this doesn't detract from the overall quality of the sunglasses.

    The functionality of the KALIYADI sunglasses is impressive. They've proven to be excellent in blocking sunlight, even on the brightest of days. Despite their light weight, they are effective, enabling me to fully enjoy my time outdoors without any glaring disturbances.

    But the most compelling advantage of these sunglasses is their affordability. They offer similar, if not better, protection compared to high-end brands like Raybans, without breaking the bank. It provides a sense of ease, knowing that even if they are misplaced, they can be replaced without causing a dent in your pocket.

    In a nutshell, the KALIYADI Polarized Sunglasses are a great buy. They are stylish, practical, and accessible – an absolute steal for their price. It's no wonder they've become my go-to sunglasses!

    I bought the two pack on amazon prime day at a great price. I’ve got a bag full of sunglasses to chose from but went ahead and got them anyway. I’m so glad I did because they’re awesome. They are big and cover the eyes very well. I have a small head and the unisex style I think is the cause of them seeming a bit big, but they are very good sunglasses and I think that you’ll love them as much as I do so yes, “I do recommend them.” 4* due to size and fit, otherwise I’d give them five.*

    OkAy, it’s been over a year that I’ve had this pair, not that I didn’t get two when I purchased them more than a year ago, but the black ones, which were my favorite pair got stolen away from me. Aside from that which is a bummer I have to admit I want to say that after more than a year of having this Pair of sunglasses that I upgraded my four star review to five stars because of how well they have held up over this year. I also want to say that I bought them on prime day that July prime day, and I got a really good deal for two pairs of glasses on the other hand when I’m reading reviews about the glasses, I noticed that some people say that the lenses are great but the frames are cheap, well I am here to tell you that I am taking good enough care of my sunglasses that I know that if you bend them they’re going to bend, you know you can force them to bend you can do that on a pair of $300 sunglasses too, but my point is people should not put a review on that is solely to say the frames are cheap or some of the photos I see that obviously, they were stepped on okay, they didn’t break by their self like that, something happened. I don’t live in a house that doesn’t have normal things going on and you drop stuff or you have a toddler. But please be honest, if you tank it. I think that a lot of the pictures I am looking at are just accidents where people broke their sunglasses and then post a picture trying to get the seller to give him a new pair, at least that’s what I thinks going on, and it’s wrong, that is wrong people if you step on your sunglasses, they didn’t break by themselves, you stepped on them, just admit it, don’t be a Fraud or a phony or are just trying to get the seller to give you something for free, at their expense, that’s just not the American way or is it just your way and maybe we’re different, but I don’t do that stuff because I think it’s wrong. I was raised better, I teach my children better, And my grandchildren know better; so for all you people who broke your own sunglasses and posted that they broke, like just fell apart, yeah they just broke. I don’t believe you and you shouldn’t do stuff that you know is wrong, just saying. Okay, lecture over.

    Anyone else out there if you want to get a really good pair of sunglasses that fit your face and hold on please remember that they’re unisex, as stated in the description, so they might be a little bit bigger on females than they are on a big headed man, which is what they are, bigger than us, so if you’re worried about that then go find yourself a pair that are not unisex or don’t complain if they are a little bit bigger than you expected and then write a review that they were bigger than you expected. Just sayin... duhh.......

About this Item

  • ★ Protect Your Eyes With Style ▶ We created our polarized sunglasses men women to protect your eyes while you are out under the harmful sun UV rays and to make you look Irresistible at the same time. Whether you are driving, walking or working, whether you are a man or a woman, prepare yourself for all the prime attention you can get and the envy of all of those who can’t figure out your little secret: Your KALIYADI Sunglasses.
  • ★ Be More Relaxed Every Day ▶ Those sunglasses come with top rated polarized lenses that we tested over time. Polarization reduces glare reflected by mirrors, shiny or polished materials or any other kind of sun rays reflection. You will feel your eyes permanently relaxed because you will not squint anymore! Whether you are driving to work or having a nice sunbath on the beach, you will be less tired at the end of the day because your eyes are more relaxed.
  • ★ See The World In Its True Colors ▶ The HD polarized lens of our sunglasses mens offer true color perception because of the neutral color coating and clear vision by eliminating reflected and scattered light. Therefore you will be able to enjoy the sunglasses during all outdoor activities, driving, fishing or any water sport as well. Just imagine how good you will feel not having to worry about eyes health while being able to enjoy and admire the world in every beautiful detail.
  • ★ Move Free And Feel Free ▶ We know how uncomfortable frames can be and how this affects every wearer. We care about your vision and want to help you keep your sun glasses on for as long as you need them. Therefore we picked ultra-light materials for glasses frame, shatterproof polarized lenses and we took care so that every edge is smoothed and polished so you’ll even forget that you wear them out in the sun. Wearing sunglasses has never been more relaxing, secure and comfortable than now!
  • ★ Gift Idea Package and Brand Customer Service ▶ Classic sunglasses*2, microfiber pouch*2, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*2, gift box*1. Our sunglasses for men women are also gift packed, which will be great gifts for your family and friends! All KALIYADI customers enjoy brand customer service for our polarized sunglasses. The integrity of every box and the quality of the lenses are double checked by third-party companies. And that goes with a lifetime support!
